# TaxPosition

An estimated tax position for an estate in a specific jurisdiction, including gross and net values, available exemptions, and estimated liability

Source: [`v3/common/tax-position.json`](../../../v3/common/tax-position.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/common/tax-position.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `jurisdiction` | `string` | yes | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or ISO 3166-2 subdivision code identifying the tax jurisdiction |
| `calculatedAt` | `string` (date-time) | yes | ISO 8601 date-time when this tax position was computed |
| `grossEstateValue` | [Money](money.md) | yes | Total gross value of the estate before deducting liabilities, in minor currency units |
| `netEstateValue` | [Money](money.md) | | Net estate value after deducting liabilities, in minor currency units |
| `lifetimeTransfersInLookback` | [Money](money.md) | | Total value of lifetime transfers (gifts, settlements) made within the lookback period, in minor currency units |
| `lookbackPeriod` | `string` | | The lookback period for lifetime transfers in this jurisdiction, expressed as a human-readable duration |
| `availableExemptions` | array of `object` | | Tax exemptions and reliefs that may reduce the taxable estate. Each entry describes one exemption, its value, and whether it has been applied |
| `taxableEstate` | [Money](money.md) | | The estate value subject to tax after applying exemptions, in minor currency units |
| `estimatedLiability` | [Money](money.md) | | The estimated tax due, in minor currency units. This is an estimate and should not be treated as a final liability |
| `effectiveRate` | `number` | | The effective tax rate as a percentage of the gross estate value |
| `warnings` | array of `string` | | Data gaps, simplifying assumptions, or other caveats that may affect the accuracy of this estimate |
| `disclaimer` | `string` | yes | A mandatory disclaimer stating that this is an estimate and not professional tax advice |
| `charitableReliefApplicable` | `boolean` | | Whether the estate qualifies for a reduced tax rate due to charitable giving (e.g. UK 36% IHT rate when 10%+ left to charity) |
| `charitableReliefPercentage` | `number` | | The reduced tax rate applicable when charitable relief qualifies, as a percentage |
| `charitableReliefBasis` | `string` | | The basis for qualifying for charitable tax relief |
| `charitableReliefJurisdiction` | `string` | | ISO 3166 code of the jurisdiction whose charitable relief rules apply |
| `charitableGiftsTotal` | [Money](money.md) | | Total value of all charitable gifts in this estate, in minor currency units |
| `charitableGiftsAsPercentage` | `number` | | Charitable gifts as a percentage of the net estate value |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
